cover.title:
t3code 日增 3,047
编排控制台仍在加速
cover.dek: t3code 今天涨了 3,047 颗星，此前几天从 +1,537 升到 +2,741，脱离了之前 +1,003 到 +1,674 的区间。连续 36 天达标，编排类是眼下最稳的一条线。
cover.title_en:
t3code adds 3,047 stars in a day
and the orchestration push keeps climbing
cover.dek_en: t3code gained 3,047 stars today, up from +1,537 to +2,741 over the past few days and well clear of its earlier +1,003 to +1,674 range. It has now hit the daily bar for 36 straight days, the steadiest line in the multi-agent space.

stickers.title: 经验过期
stickers.text: 工具接口被悄悄改动后，带经验的 agent 反而不如没经验的新手。
stickers.text_en: Experience Rot finds that after a silent tool-interface change, agents with experience do worse than fresh ones.

stickers.title: 强制校验
stickers.text: SilentGuard 把静默故障下的错误答案从 74.0% 降到 1.7%
stickers.text_en: SilentGuard cuts wrong answers under silent API failures from 74.0% to 1.7%.

stickers.title: 安全新星
stickers.text: Claude-BugHunter 日增 +2,009，11-12 前每天只涨 9 到 13 颗星。
stickers.text_en: Claude-BugHunter gained 2,009 stars today, after adding only 9 to 13 a day before 11-12.
